title: Quantitative lower bounds for trace reconstruction
main_claim: For q^3 log n → ∞ and every fixed c<1/(4 log 2) and success s>0, T_{q,s}(n) ≥ n^{c log(q^3 log n)}. In particular, at fixed q, worst-case trace reconstruction needs n^{Ω(log log n)} samples, and min TV between distinct n-bit words' trace laws is o(n^{-A}) for every A.
sibling_notes: Family 122 sibling (rank495, latest-anchor induction for worst-case trace reconstruction) also reported no_gap_found. The two papers rely on similar Thue–Morse and binomial smoothing. This paper says it is independent of the companion upper-bound paper; I found no circular dependence.
